method.normalization: shotDmg=100 for formula and movement control; nativeLv13 for finiteHP
method.movement: actual Main.enemyMoveSpeed,predictEnemyPosition,moveEnemy; no enemy attacks,waves or other tower attacks
method.fixtures: boss=one large target; dense12=4x3 spacing35; medium12=4x3 spacing70; scatter6=3x2 spacing220; all move down together
method.finite: nativeLv13 same three skills fully upgraded, but only support is cast; effectiveHP loss clamped to survivingHP; deaths remove target before next movement
method.excludes: relics,talents,store,synergy,other attacks,rewards; no modifications to game data
